frequency_question: How often does Congress successfully pass a joint resolution blocking such an executive agreement within the statutory review window?
membership_rule: Includes formal 123 agreements or equivalent major nuclear cooperation pacts transmitted to Congress requiring affirmative legislative blocking via joint resolution. Excludes minor amendments or executive agreements not triggering statutory disapproval mechanisms.

skeleton: Total historical major bilateral nuclear cooperation or sensitive arms/tech agreements submitted for statutory congressional review where resolutions of disapproval were introduced, multiplied by the fraction resulting in successful override-proof passage.
